Name: Storage Apparel
Author: TimBukTw0
Description:
[b][size=4]UPDATE: So as you know this is a combo of the other two mods BUT make sure you take out your items from the RingGloves and your Hat upon swapping to this one as they DO NOT transfer over. ALSO this mod will update your RingGlove items if you leave them in your ring slots automatically on the first load so you don't need to rebuy them.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Storage Apparel[/size][/b]
Why stop at one mod when you can have them all? After thinking about it I decided to combine all three of my item storage mods into one.

Ever tired of not being able to wear a hat over the pan on your head? Well now you can. Storage Apparel gives every hat a hidden pan slot, ready for your Pan or Milk Pail no matter which hat you're wearing. Your pan lives in its own little pocket dimension, so swapping hats never loses it. But why stop there? Tuck tools or weapons into your shirt like you're slinging them over your shoulder, stash items in your pants pockets, and hide things in your boots. On top of all that, equip Ring Gloves: specially crafted items that let you wear extra rings on each hand, with a powerful Dwarven upgrade available through Marlon's shop once you've proven yourself a true monster hunter. And for the last addition: a Magic Hair Dye slot in the trinket slot cause its a CRIME that you need to replace your trinket with it just to have cool hair.

[b]Warning:[/b] Every effort has been made to ensure items save and restore correctly, including enchantments, attachments, and special attributes. Fishing rods in particular nearly broke the dev. Everything should work, but the occasional edge case may mangle an item with unusual properties — you've been warned. Should work in multiplayer, but if it doesn't, bug reports are welcome!
[b]Incompatibilities:[/b] Any mod that changes how the inventory system works, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3214]Wear More Rings[/url], will likely conflict with Ring Gloves. This mod was designed as a balanced alternative to wearing more rings: compatibility with similar mods is not planned. Rings added by other mods may also not function correctly due to how the glove system was implemented.

Manifest.Name: Storage Apparel
Manifest.Description: Store items in your clothing slots, tuck tools under your hat, and wear extra rings with Ring Gloves.
